en.text: Hi, I'm Emanuel Borges, a Senior Full Stack Developer based in Manaus, Brazil, working fully remote.
I have more than ten years of experience building systems with PHP, Python, C++, Java, Node.js, React and React Native, on large-scale projects at INDT, ICCT and Manaus City Hall.

Today my focus is Artificial Intelligence as a plus for creating intelligent applications, with specializations in RAG, semantic search, NLP, and postgraduate degrees in Machine Learning Engineering and Natural Language Processing.
The assistant that answers your questions on this portfolio was built by me, in three languages and at zero cost.
This spoken presentation is an example of my professional profile, and I'm open to new opportunities, so let's talk.

Hoje meu foco é Inteligência Artificial como um plus para a criação de aplicativos inteligentes, com especializações em RAG, busca semântica, NLP, e pós-graduações em Machine Learning Engineering e Processamento de Linguagem Natural.
